raw.details:
Overview:

Think. Innovate. Pitch.

NEXUS InnovateX 2026 is a two-round innovation and ideation challenge designed to encourage students and young innovators to identify real-world problems, develop meaningful solutions, and explore the practical application of AI and emerging technologies.

The competition takes participants through a structured journey from idea validation to idea development and pitching, providing an opportunity to demonstrate problem-solving ability, innovation, technological awareness, and presentation skills.

For further communication, important updates, and evaluation-related information, join the official WhatsApp group: https://chat.whatsapp.com/Ko1ShZUBgnMK6foJOAFIpd

Round 1 — IdeaCheck: Innovation & Idea Validation Quiz:

The first round is an objective-based quiz designed to assess participants' understanding of innovation, problem-solving, AI and technology, business fundamentals, user and market understanding, logical decision-making, and idea validation.

Format:

  • 20 MCQs
  • 15 Minutes
  • Online Mode
  • Automatic Evaluation
  • Shortlisting based on performance

Participants qualifying for Round 2 will advance to the idea development and pitching stage.

Round 2 — IdeaPitch: PPT & Video Pitch:

Shortlisted participants will develop and present an innovative idea addressing a meaningful problem, need, or opportunity.

The Idea PPT should cover:

  • Problem Statement
  • Target Users
  • Proposed Solution
  • Key Features
  • AI / Technology Used
  • Market / Use Case
  • Business Model
  • Competitive Advantage
  • Expected Impact
  • Future Scope

Participants will also submit a 2–3 minute video pitch presenting their problem, proposed solution, technological approach, uniqueness, and expected impact.

Evaluation Criteria:

Round 2 submissions will be evaluated by judges based on:

  • Innovation & Originality — 25%
  • Problem & Solution — 20%
  • Feasibility — 20%
  • Use of Technology / AI — 15%
  • Impact & Scalability — 10%
  • Pitch Quality — 10%

Recognition & Rewards:

Participants will receive recognition based on their final performance in the competition.

Winner:

  • Winner Certificate
  • Exclusive NEXUS Merchandise
  • LinkedIn Recognition on the official NEXUS LinkedIn page

1st Runner-Up:

  • 1st Runner-Up Certificate
  • LinkedIn Recognition on the official NEXUS LinkedIn page

2nd Runner-Up:

  • 2nd Runner-Up Certificate
  • LinkedIn Recognition on the official NEXUS LinkedIn page

Top 10:

  • Rank-based Certificate of Achievement for all Top 10 participants

Who Can Participate?:

NEXUS InnovateX 2026 is open to students and young innovators interested in innovation, entrepreneurship, artificial intelligence, emerging technologies, product development, and real-world problem solving.

Participants are free to explore ideas from any domain, provided the proposed concept addresses a meaningful problem, need, or opportunity.

Event Flow:

Round 1 — IdeaCheck
Innovation & Idea Validation Quiz
↓
Automatic Evaluation & Shortlisting
↓
Round 2 — IdeaPitch
PPT + Video Pitch Submission
↓
Judging & Evaluation
↓
Final Rankings & Recognition

NEXUS InnovateX 2026 provides a platform to move from identifying a problem to developing, validating, and effectively pitching an innovative solution.

Think. Innovate. Validate. Pitch.
